_comment: UI configuration. Values marked ASSUMED are not confirmed by the live site.

pricing._oddSizedItem: ASSUMED: live site shows S$29 per bag; odd-sized price not shown until an item is added

booking._sameDayCutoffHour: INFERRED from the FAQ: bookings close at 11am on the day of the flight
booking._guardSteps: true = like the live site, opening a later step without earlier data sends you to the landing page. Add ?preview=1 to any step URL to load data/booking.sample.json instead.

flow._comment: Where each page sends the user on its primary button. Values are keys of 'routes'. The landing card goes straight to Step 2 (Luggage); the Step 1 page is reached from the header 'Book Now' and from 'Edit' links.

tooltips.departureDate: Bookings can be made up to 14 days in advance
tooltips.contactNumber: We'll only contact this number in case of emergencies.
tooltips.bookingCode: Refer to your confirmation email for your booking confirmation code
tooltips.bookingPin: Refer to your confirmation email for your booking PIN

leave.title: Leave this page?
leave.body: If you exit now, your current booking progress will be cleared and you'll have to begin again.

endOfPrototype.title: End of replica flow
endOfPrototype.body: Payment is handled by CAG's payment provider and is not part of this case-study replica. Nothing has been sent or charged.

retrieveNotConnected.title: Booking lookup not connected
retrieveNotConnected.body: Retrieving a booking needs CAG's booking API. Connect it in replica/js/models/api.js (retrieveBooking).

notInReplica.title: Not part of this replica
notInReplica.body: This link opens a document that was not included in the case-study capture.

feedback._comment: Survey shown in the Give Feedback panel. The live site embeds a Qualtrics survey. Empty = grey 'could not load' panel. Set a URL to embed one.

footer._comment: Rows of the footer 'Changi Sites' dropdown on narrow screens. Plain text on the live site (no links).
